data_quality_note: No multi-GW (GW5-9) fixture schedule exists in the current cache. data/cache/squad.json, xpts.json and player_pool.json carry no fixture/opponent/loc fields at all — xpts.json only has a single scalar 'fdr' per player (this week's difficulty), and player_pool.json is pure season-to-date performance stats (no fdr field). data/features.json does contain a real fdr.next[] 5-fixture look-ahead structure, but it was generated pre-season with meta.target_gw=1, so its 'next' array covers GW1-GW5, NOT the requested GW5-GW9 window. Cross-check: for ARS, features.json's GW5 entry (fdr 3, loc 'A') matches xpts.json's current fdr=3 for Raya/Konsa/Saka, confirming the single data point we do have is reliable, but GW6-9 simply are not present anywhere in the repo cache. This report therefore ranks the real squad by the one live figure available (xpts.json fdr for GW5) and flags DGW/BGW as UNVERIFIABLE rather than guessing. Recommend Apps Script regenerate features.json against target_gw=5 before next week's run so a true rolling 5-GW FDR-X window can be produced.
